University of California, Berkeley biologist Ciera Martinez and colleagues noted that in certain plants in which leaves grow in pairs, auxins will typically be concentrated in opposite sides of each leaf in the pair (e.g., on the left side of one leaf in the pair and the right side of the other). Accordingly, they hypothesized that paired leaves should tend to show opposite side orientation, and they tested their hypothesis by examining paired leaves from several species of grapevines. 题目 89% - 0.4 0.08% Question 12 Which choice best describes data from the graph that support Martinez and colleague' hypothesis?
